definitions.explanation: The beginning or cause of something.
Indicating something or someone's previous state or position.
The original state or foundation of something.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{私|わたし}の{元|もと}カレだ。
{火|ひ}の{元|もと}に{気|き}をつけてください。
examples.english: Please be careful with fire sources.
To return to the original state.

notes:
MULTIPLE MEANINGS:

1. ORIGIN/SOURCE:
・{火|ひ}の{元|もと} (source of fire)
・{栄養|えいよう}の{元|もと} (source of nutrition)
・{病気|びょうき}の{元|もと} (cause of illness)

2. FORMER/EX-:
・{元|もと}カレ/{元|もと}カノ (ex-boyfriend/ex-girlfriend)
・{元|もと}{社長|しゃちょう} (former president)
・{元|もと}の{場所|ばしょ} (the original place)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{元|もと}に{戻|もど}す (to restore, put back)
・{元|もと}の{通|とお}り (as it was before)
・{元|もと}はと{言|い}えば (originally speaking)

RELATED KANJI:
・{基|もと} (basis, foundation)
・{素|もと} (element, base material)
